description:
Activate The Jolly Balloon Man by paying {1} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Icewind Stalwart that is a 1/1 Balloon with flying and haste in addition to its other types.
The token copy of Icewind Stalwart enters, triggering itself and Mana Echoes.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding at least {C}{C}.
Resolve the Icewind Stalwart trigger, blinking The Jolly Balloon Man.
Repeat.
